keyPoints.en: Marketing = identifying customer needs, then promoting and selling. Marketing mix: Product, Price, Place, Promotion.
keyPoints.bm: Pemasaran = mengenal pasti keperluan pelanggan, kemudian mempromosi dan menjual. Campuran pemasaran: Produk, Harga, Tempat, Promosi.

keyPoints.en: Design attracts attention, builds the brand and communicates benefits.
keyPoints.bm: Reka bentuk menarik perhatian, membina jenama dan menyampaikan kelebihan.

keyPoints.en: Methods: posters, brochures, banners, social media, videos, websites, packaging, billboards.
keyPoints.bm: Kaedah: poster, risalah, kain rentang, media sosial, video, laman web, pembungkusan, papan iklan.

keyPoints.en: Choose by target audience, cost and reach; analyse strengths and weaknesses of each method.
keyPoints.bm: Pilih berdasarkan khalayak sasaran, kos dan capaian; analisis kekuatan dan kelemahan setiap kaedah.

keyPoints.en: Produce the advert using AIDA: Attention → Interest → Desire → Action; keep it honest.
keyPoints.bm: Hasilkan iklan menggunakan AIDA: Perhatian → Minat → Keinginan → Tindakan; pastikan jujur.
